title: An fNIRS dataset for driving risk cognition of passengers in highly automated driving scenarios
description: This dataset contains functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) recordings of prefrontal cortex activity from 20 participants (ages 21-46; 5 female, 15 male) in a driving simulator. Participants experienced fourteen types of highly automated driving scenarios, and the dataset accompanies scenario data and subjective danger ratings. It is intended to support study of prefrontal activity differences between low-risk and high-risk driving episodes, with potential application to brain-computer interfaces and improving safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF).
methods_description: An 8-channel fNIRS device recorded prefrontal cortex activity while 20 participants completed 12 driving simulator tasks each (240 planned tasks; 20 removed due to incorrect recording). Scenario data and subjective evaluations of the danger level of each VTD scenario segment are provided in participants.tsv.
